title: BiasMix-Finance: Post-Generation KYC Guardrails for LLM Portfolio Advice
abstract: arXiv:2608.28646v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate plausible-sounding ETF portfolios while silently violating basic KYC-style constraints on risk, fees, and diversification. This is especially problematic in agentic multi-turn advisory systems, where each draft recommendation can become an action unless guarded by an auditable enforcement layer. We study a model-agnostic, asset-agnostic post-generation guardrail pipeline: (i) enforce a strict JSON allocation schema, (ii) validate allocations against numeric caps, and (iii) when violations occur, deterministically project the output to the nearest feasible portfolio via a convex quadratic program (QCQP). We introduce BiasMix-Finance (Mini), a compact stress-test benchmark for constrained decision-making under biased LLM generations, with a 16-ETF universe, three investor profiles, and eight bias prompts. translated_title: BiasMix-Finance：面向大语言模型投资组合建议的生成后KYC护栏
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）能够生成听起来合理的ETF投资组合，却可能悄然违反关于风险、费用和分散化的基本KYC式约束。这一问题在智能体多轮咨询系统中尤为突出，因为每份草稿建议都可能直接转化为行动，除非有可审计的执行层加以防护。我们研究了一种模型无关、资产无关的生成后护栏流水线：（i）强制执行严格的JSON配置格式；（ii）根据数值上限校验配置；（iii）当出现违规时，通过凸二次规划（QCQP）确定性地将输出投影到最近的可满足约束的投资组合。我们提出了BiasMix-Finance（Mini），一个用于测试有偏LLM生成下受限决策能力的紧凑压力测试基准，包含16只ETF的资产池、三种投资者画像和八种偏差提示。在三个模型和三种推理模式（直接、批判、自洽性）下，首次通过……
tldr: 提出了一种模型无关的生成后KYC护栏流水线，通过严格JSON模式校验与凸二次规划投影，将违反风险、费用和分散化约束的LLM投资组合建议确定性地修正为最近的可满足解，并发布了BiasMix-Finance压力测试基准。
en_tdlr: Proposes a model-agnostic post-generation guardrail pipeline that enforces strict JSON schemas and deterministically projects violated LLM portfolio outputs to the nearest feasible allocation via convex quadratic programming, accompanied by the BiasMix-Finance stress-test benchmark.
